name: cozea/electron-app
install: command -v bun >/dev/null || curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash; export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; bun install; test -f .env.local || printf 'VITE_CONVEX_URL=https://knowing-finch-546.convex.cloud\n' > .env.local

terminals.name: app-dev
terminals.description: Electron + Vite dev on Cloud Agent display :1. Kills stale electron-vite processes before start to avoid Vite port drift (5183→5184) and 504 dynamic-import failures.
